newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope meets Aznar, urges religious education.
newsitem.headline: Pope meets Aznar, urges religious education.

text.p: Pope John Paul underlined the need for religious instruction in school, family values and the defence of life at talks with Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar on Thursday, the Vatican said.
Chief Vatican spokesman Joaquin Navarro-Valls said the cordial 30-minute audience with the conservative prime minister covered all areas of mutual interest, including Latin America.
He said Aznar had brought the Pontiff a personal message from Spain's King Juan Carlos but gave no details.
Navarro-Valls said the Vatican laid particular importance on religious instruction in the mainly Roman Catholic country.
"I told him he was looking in top form," Aznar told reporters after his audience with the Pope and a meeting with the Vatican's Secretary of State, Cardinal Angelo Sodano.

Aznar was due to meet members of Spanish religious congregations before flying home on Thursday afternoon. He was accompanied by Foreign Minister Abel Matutes but no meetings with the Italian government were planned, diplomats said.
